zh.title: 美航要求暫停芝加哥奧黑爾機場登機門重分配 上訴法院維持駁回
zh.summary: 伊利諾州上訴法院維持拒發暫時禁制令的裁定。裁定範圍是登機門重分配是否應暫停。
body: 伊利諾州上訴法院11月19日維持下級法院裁定，駁回美國航空要求暫停芝加哥奧黑爾國際機場登機門重分配的請求。芝加哥市於2025年依機場使用與租賃協議啟動調整，美國航空主張協議禁止在2027年前重分配。
法院指出，調整已實施，但仍可能撤回，因此上訴仍有審理意義。法院認為，下級法院在衡量暫停調整對航空公司既定班表、旅客與機場運作的影響時，沒有濫用裁量權。此次裁定處理暫時禁制令，合約爭議的實體主張仍待裁判。

en.title: Illinois appellate court upholds denial of bid to halt O’Hare gate reallocation
en.summary: The court left in place the denial of American Airlines’ preliminary injunction request in the Chicago O’Hare gate dispute.
body: An Illinois appellate court on November 19 upheld a lower court’s refusal to halt the reallocation of gates at Chicago O’Hare International Airport. Chicago began the reallocation in 2025 under the airport’s airline use and lease agreement. American Airlines argued that the agreement barred it before 2027.

The panel held that the appeal could still be heard because the reallocation could be reversed. It found that the lower court acted within its discretion in weighing the effects on airline schedules, passengers and airport operations. The order addressed interim relief and left the merits of the contract dispute unresolved.

facts.claim: The court affirmed the denial of a preliminary injunction against the gate reallocation.
It found that the appeal remained live and that the lower court did not abuse its discretion in weighing the harms.
